title: brief CLI max-line test is wall-clock flaky under load
body:
Outcome: the brief CLI maximum-sized section line test does not fail on a loaded host while still bounding the brief CLI's cost.
Evidence: krn verify preflight on e38f272 at load ~27: "not ok 7 - brief CLI handles maximum-sized section lines before its one-second deadline", spawnSync node ETIMEDOUT (.krn/runs/lead/landing/verify2.log); passed on rerun (verify3.log).
Proof: the test measures the CLI's own work (e.g. CPU time or an in-process call) instead of a wall-clock spawn deadline; it passes under a CPU-saturating stub load.
